blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) on Saturday ordered five popular online shopping platforms to submit records of their accredited truck-for-hire service providers. The order comes as the board intensifies its crackdown on illegal delivery operators. Acting LTFRB chair Greg Pua Jr. said he had issued subpoenas directing the service providers of Lazada, Shopee, Zalora, TikTok Shop and SM Retail Inc. to submit complete and updated lists of their accredited truck-for-hire partners. The agency also told them to present supporting documents. The online shopping companies were given three working days upon the receipt of the directives to […]...
